title: Joy Unspeakable
alsoKnownAs: I Have Found His Grace Is All Complete
description: Joy Unspeakable in Tonic Solfa to JOY UNSPEAKABLE: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the 4 verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Barney E. Warren, an American hymn writer and minister of the Church of God (Anderson), wrote both the words and the tune JOY UNSPEAKABLE in 1900.
underlay: I have found His grace is all com-plete, He sup-pli-eth eve-ry need; While I sit and learn at Je-sus’ feet, I am free, yes, free in-deed. It is joy un-speak-a-ble and full of glo-ry, Full of glo-ry, full of glo-ry; It is joy un-speak-a-ble and full of glo-ry, Oh, the half has nev-er yet been told.

lines: I have found His grace is all complete,
He supplieth every need;
While I sit and learn at Jesus’ feet,
I am free, yes, free indeed.

verses.label: Refrain
lines: It is joy unspeakable and full of glory,
Full of glory, full of glory;
It is joy unspeakable and full of glory,
Oh, the half has never yet been told.
I have found the pleasure I once craved,
It is joy and peace within;
What a wondrous blessing, I am saved
From the awful gulf of sin.
I have found that hope so bright and clear,
Living in the realm of grace;
Oh, the Saviour’s presence is so near,
I can see His smiling face.
I have found the joy no tongue can tell,
How its waves of glory roll;
It is like a great o’erflowing well,
Springing up within my soul.
